This task is the authoritative root-completion record because Beads cannot use task-to-epic blocker edges. It must verify every milestone proof and clean-checkout release acceptance before the root epic closes.

## Ownership and command-endpoint hardening
`run` owns a bounded Unix-domain mutating command endpoint and persists idempotent request/result records; status TCP remains read-only. Requests bind a server-issued per-dry-run nonce, ID, run/epoch/config/table-set/anchor/generation fingerprints, nonce-bearing digest/expiry, and peer identity; prior-run nonterminal requests abort after intent reconciliation and never auto-reexecute. Offline mutations acquire both locks and reconcile. The source advisory lock uses a dedicated non-pooled backend PID/nonce plus monotonic ownership deadline; uncertain advisory-lock or unexpected CopyBoth loss fences all dispatch and exits without in-place reacquire/reopen, and supervised successors wait then reconcile.

## Monotonic external promotion fencing
Allocate a strictly increasing destination-scoped promotion fence in each durable intent. External selectors enforce greater-fence wins; lower fences are no-ops and same-fence/different-state is corruption. ClickHouse uses query-time resolution over a pre-created append-only selector and generation-keyed shared history; no DDL switch participates. Archive uses immutable fence-named selector markers. External state ahead of restored SQLite blocks until maintenance verifies/adopts the highest fence or rejects the external state.

## Archive path-safety hardening
All path components use frozen ASCII encodings of opaque IDs/hashes/epochs/generations/fences/ranges; raw or sanitized source identifiers are forbidden and display mappings live in hashed manifests. Operate descriptor-relative below an opened root with no-follow/exclusive creation and reject symlinks, type swaps, unexpected hard links, owner/mode mismatches, and non-directory intermediates.

## Standalone implementation and evidence contract
Standalone execution contract
This Bead is sufficient for implementation and closure. PLAN/REQUIREMENTS links are navigation only. Preserve the fixed topology: one PostgreSQL source/database/publication/pgoutput slot, one Rust binary and SQLite journal, ClickHouse plus one scheduled JSONL/Parquet archive; durable-before-feedback; destination-independent capture; at-least-once delivery with idempotent convergence; bounded resources; fail-closed unsupported behavior; no cross-epoch version comparison. Values selected by M0 are copied as literals into this Bead or its produced contract before readiness; unresolved/TBD values block readiness.

Inputs, outputs, and ownership
Implement only this Bead's named domain transitions. Consume predecessor artifacts by immutable ID/digest; do not re-own their transitions. State changes use the capture-priority writer and complete SQLite transactions where applicable. External effects require an immutable intent, generation/epoch namespace, reconciliation, and checkpoint advancement only at complete journal transaction boundaries. Every failure names its class, stable fingerprint, failed boundary, allowed actions, and recovery.

Security and observability
Emit redacted JSONL with `schema_version`, monotonically increasing `case_event_seq`, `bead_id`, `scenario_id`, `correlation_id`, `run_id`, `capture_epoch`, `component`, `phase`, `outcome`, `config_fingerprint`, and as applicable `generation`, `intent_id`, `request_id`, XID, commit/end LSN, journal range, anchor/fence, attempt, fault hook, failure class/fingerprint, metric units, and evidence digest. JSON null is used for inapplicable fields. Never log payload values, canonical keys/tuples, snapshot tokens, DSNs, credentials, dry-run nonces, raw driver errors, secret environment names/values, raw source identifiers, or absolute/unapproved paths.

Deterministic evidence
Own comprehensive unit/contract tests for every branch, limit, invalid input, state transition, crash boundary, retry, and stale completion in this Bead. Required commands are `cargo test --locked --workspace --all-targets`, a Bead-specific test filter, `scripts/e2e/m7_release.sh`, and `scripts/faults/m7_release.sh`. Scripts run from a clean checkout, create isolated volumes/state with fixed seed/profile, build/start pinned Compose services, wait by health conditions rather than sleeps, execute named fault hooks, assert exact state/checkpoint/external effects and metrics, collect evidence, and tear down via a trap. Run twice to prove reproducibility.

Artifacts
Write `artifacts/boring-cdc-m7-release/<scenario_id>/<seed>/` containing `manifest.json`, `commands.txt`, `versions.json`, redacted `config.json`, `logs/boring-cdc.jsonl`, `state/before.json`, `state/after.json`, `fault-timeline.json`, oracle/packet evidence when applicable, stdout/stderr, and SHA-256 inventory. `manifest.json` records schema version, Bead/case, git and binary hashes, image digests, seed/profile, exact commands/exit codes, configuration and source/table fingerprints, assertions, artifact hashes, outcome, and failure fingerprint. Closure records artifact paths/digests and proves log-schema/redaction checks pass.
